Position.Name: Button position
Position.Hint: Where the expanded buttons appear on each window. This choice is per user. Detached windows always use the header.
Position.Left: Bar on the left of the window
Position.Right: Bar on the right of the window

SheetsOnly.Name: Sheets only
SheetsOnly.Hint: Expand the buttons only on document sheets (actors, items, journals…). Turn off to expand them on every window, including settings and dialogs.

GmOnly.Name: GM only
GmOnly.Hint: If enabled, only the GM gets the expanded buttons. Players keep the default three-dot menu.

Menu.Name: Configure buttons
Menu.Label: Choose which buttons to expand
Menu.Hint: Pick, one by one, which buttons leave the three-dot menu. The list grows as you open windows with new buttons.

Config.Title: Expand Header Buttons — Buttons
Config.Intro: Checked buttons are shown expanded. Unchecked buttons stay in the three-dot menu.
Config.Empty: No buttons found yet. Open a sheet once and come back.
